hint_ladder: Push back on the other person's claim by naming your own doubt, not their mistake.
Say what you are not yet persuaded of, and let them meet the doubt with evidence.
Start with the words: ___ the cheaper option lasts.
teaching_content.reveal_form: I'm not convinced the cheaper option lasts.
canonical_forms: I'm not convinced the cheaper option lasts.
alternative_realizations: I'm not convinced — show me the numbers.
